column1: # The callout vocabulary: single source of truth for conventions/callout-boxes.md v2.
# Read by box.sh (agent side) and hook-common.sh hook_box_kind (hook side).
# Admission = a row here + a Ghostty render-check + the spec table note.

column6: when
advisory nudge from a hook; act or dismiss
blocking gate; the turn cannot proceed as-is
something sent out; landing will follow
something came back; verify before trusting
incoming mail owed a reply
outgoing send awaiting a reply
mistake recorded; xN carries recurrence
affirmed-good call recorded
standing rule invoked before acting
completion report; arrow = what needs the reader
ambient lesson; line-tag only
educational aside; multi-line hanging indent allowed
context pressure notice; line-tag only
unread board notes; line-tag only
a session resumed from a checkpoint: what was done, what is next, what waits on the owner
session state saved for a later /catchup: where it went, what it carries, what to paste
a session goal armed / re-armed / awaiting the owner; the paste line follows the box, bare
three or more seats dispatched together; one row per seat with its cost estimate
the same fleet landing; one row per seat with time, cost and whether it wrote its output
gcc improvement proposal filed; the show command follows the box, bare
i-dream insight pinned; the show command follows the box, bare
